export interface ActionCallContext extends ActionCallOrigin {
    readonly actor_id: string;
    readonly memory_read_mode?: "explicit" | "task";
    readonly memory_operation_id?: string;
    readonly assistant_reply?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/assistant").AssistantReplyDelivery;
    readonly page_context?: {
        readonly url: string | null;
        readonly title: string | null;
        readonly provenance: "host_snapshot" | "client_reported";
    };
    readonly locale?: ActionLocale;
    readonly audit_actor_id?: string;
    readonly delegated_by?: string;
    readonly runtime_session_id?: string;
    readonly runtime_session_missing?: true;
    readonly actor_kind?: "user" | "runtime" | null;
    readonly user_action?: ActionUserAction;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly audience: ActionAudience;
    readonly readable_project_ids?: readonly string[];
    readonly plugin_install_id?: string;
    readonly host_plugin?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/app-host").HostPluginCaller;
    readonly original_file?: HostOfferedOriginalFile;
    readonly original_input?: HostOfferedOriginalInput;
    readonly query_only?: true;
    readonly read_only_effects?: true;
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_capability_ids?: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_actions?: readonly ActionReference[];
    readonly validate_authority?: (reference: ActionReference) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly assert_authority_current?: (reference?: ActionReference, requiredPermissions?: readonly string[]) => void;
    readonly validate_permissions?: (permissions: readonly string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly retain_background_authority?: (references: readonly ActionReference[], additionalPermissions?: readonly string[]) => RetainedActionAuthority;
    readonly on_progress?: (event: {
        readonly stage: string;
        readonly progress: number;
        readonly text_delta?: string;
    }) => void;
    readonly scene_binding?: {
        readonly scene_id: string;
        readonly binding_id: string;
    };
}

    readonly call_id?: string;

export declare class ActionError extends Error {
    readonly code: string;
    readonly kind?: ActionErrorKind;
    readonly details?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    constructor(code: string, message: string, options?: ActionErrorOptions);
}

export type ActionErrorKind = (typeof ACTION_ERROR_KIND_NAMES)[number];

export interface ActionErrorOptions {
    readonly kind?: ActionErrorKind;
    readonly details?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    readonly cause?: unknown;
}

    readonly retainBackgroundAuthority?: (additionalPermissions?: readonly string[]) => RetainedActionAuthority;
}

export interface ActionMetadata {
    readonly title: string;

    readonly output_type?: string;

        readonly role: "context" | "reply";

    };
    readonly home_aggregate?: true;

        readonly id: string;

        readonly status: {
            readonly capability_id: string;
            readonly version: number;
        };
        readonly id: string;
        readonly input: string;
        readonly state: string;

        readonly failed: readonly string[];
    };

        readonly capability_id: string;
        readonly version: number;
        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, string | readonly [string]>>;
    };
}

                        pattern: string;
                        minLength: number;
                        type: string;
                    };
                    id: {
                        type: string[];
                        minLength: number;
                    };
                    title: {
                        minLength: number;
                        type: string;
                    };
                    label: {
                        minLength: number;
                        type: string;
                    };
                };
                required: string[];
                additionalProperties: boolean;
                anyOf: ({
                    properties: {
                        kind: {
                            const: string;
                            enum?: undefined;
                        };
                        id: {
                            type: string;
                        };
                    };
                } | {
                    properties: {
                        kind: {
                            enum: string[];
                            const?: undefined;
                        };
                        id: {
                            minLength: number;
                            type: string;
                        };
                    };
                })[];
            } | {
                type: string;
            })[];
        };
    };
    required: string[];
    additionalProperties: boolean;
};

export interface PluginExecutor {
    start(definition: PluginDefinition, context: PluginStartContext): Promise<PluginExecutorHandle>;

    restorePrivateData?(installId: string, snapshot: unknown): Promise<void> | void;
    uninstalled?(record: PluginInstanceRecord): Promise<void> | void;
    prepareReinstall?(record: PluginInstanceRecord): void;
    keptDataDiscarded?(record: PluginInstanceRecord): void;
}

    contribution: PluginContribution;

    readonly actions?: PluginActionClient;

    readonly project_database?: import("platform/plugin-database").PluginProjectDatabase;
    readonly project_statements?: import("platform/plugin-database").PluginProjectStatements;
    readonly scheduler?: import("platform/plugin-scheduler").PluginScheduleClient;
    readonly ownerFiles?: import("platform/plugin-owner-files").PluginOwnerFilesClient;
    readonly terminal?: PluginTerminalClient;
    readonly model?: PluginModelClient;
    readonly imageGeneration?: import("platform/plugin-image-generation").PluginImageGenerationClient;
    readonly localTools?: import("platform/plugin-local-tools").PluginLocalToolsClient;
    readonly materials?: PluginMaterialsClient;
    readonly connections?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-connections").PluginConnectionsClient;
    readonly directory?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-directory").PluginDirectoryService;
    readonly artifacts?: PluginArtifactClient;
    readonly processItems?: PluginProcessItemClient;
    readonly ui: PluginUiClient;
    readonly interaction?: import("platform/plugin-interaction").PluginInteractionClient;
    readonly events?: PluginEventsClient;
    readonly inputs?: PluginInputsClient;
    readonly outputs?: PluginOutputsClient;
}

export interface PluginManifest {
    schema_version: 1 | 2;
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
    name: string;
    kind: PluginKind;
    publisher: {
        publisher_id: string;
        signature: string;
    };
    host_api_version: 1 | 2;
    always_on?: boolean;
    summary?: string;
    developer?: true;
    entrypoints: PluginEntrypointManifest[];
    permissions: PluginPermissionDeclaration[];
    capabilities: {
        provides: string[];
        consumes: string[];
    };
    artifacts: {
        produces: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
            title?: string;
            preview?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            pin?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            compare?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            continue?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
        }>;
        consumes: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
            continue?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            file?: ArtifactFileDeclaration;
        }>;
        links?: ArtifactLinkDeclaration[];
    };
    process_items?: {
        produces: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
        }>;
        consumes: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
        }>;
    };
    ui: {
        contributions: string[];
        embedded_plugins?: string[];
        views?: UiViewDeclaration[];
        messages?: PluginMessagesDeclaration;
        translations?: PluginTranslationsDeclaration;
    };
    ports?: PluginPortsDeclaration;
    events?: PluginEventsDeclaration;
    routes?: PluginRouteDeclaration[];
    requires?: PluginRequirementDeclaration[];
    agent?: AgentManifest;
    methods?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-agent").AgentSkillDeclaration[];
    upgrade_compatibility?: PluginUpgradeCompatibilityDeclaration;
    databases?: import("platform/plugin-database").PluginManifestDatabases;
    owner_files?: import("platform/plugin-owner-files").PluginOwnerFilesDeclaration;
    model_configuration?: import("platform/plugin-model-configuration").PluginModelConfigurationDeclaration;
    image_generation?: import("platform/plugin-image-generation").PluginImageGenerationDeclaration;
    runtime?: PluginRuntimeDeclaration;
    local_tools?: import("platform/plugin-local-tools").PluginLocalToolsDeclaration;
    attention?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-attention").PluginAttentionDeclaration;
    connections?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-connections").PluginConnectionsDeclaration;
    background?: {
        jobs: readonly import("platform/plugin-background").PluginJobDeclaration[];
        wakeups?: readonly import("platform/plugin-scheduler").PluginWakeupDeclaration[];
    };
    actions?: readonly import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionDefinition[];
    action_scenes?: readonly import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionSceneDefinition[];
}

    type: "error";

};

export interface PluginRuntimeApi {
    register(definition: PluginDefinition): void;
    install(input: {
        definition: PluginDefinition;
        deployment: PluginDeployment;
        grants?: string[];
        retain_private_data?: boolean;
    }): PluginLifecycleReceipt;
    upgrade(input: {
        install_id: string;
        definition: PluginDefinition;
        deployment?: PluginDeployment;
        grants?: string[];
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    rollback(input: {
        install_id: string;
        definition: PluginDefinition;
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    grant(installId: string, permissions: string[]): PluginLifecycleReceipt;
    start(installId: string): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    stop(installId: string, options?: {
        preserve_enabled?: boolean;
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    reportCrash(installId: string, errorCode?: string): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    recover(installId: string, options?: {
        release_quarantine?: boolean;
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    uninstall(installId: string, options?: {
        retain_private_data?: boolean;
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;
    get(installId: string): PluginInstanceRecord;
    list(): PluginInstanceRecord[];
    contribution(installId: string): PluginContribution | null;
}

    readonly scope: "home";
}

}

export interface WorkExecutorActionOptions {

export interface WorkExecutorCalls {
    state: {
        input: Record<string, never>;
        output: WorkExecutorState;
    };
    "session.open": {
        input: WorkExecutorSessionOpen;
        output: WorkExecutorSessionRef;
    };
    "session.read": {
        input: WorkExecutorSessionReadInput;
        output: WorkExecutorSession;
    };
    "session.update": {
        input: WorkExecutorSessionUpdate;
        output: WorkExecutorSessionUpdate;
    };
    "run.start": {
        input: WorkExecutorRunStart;
        output: WorkExecutorRunStarted;
    };
    "run.control": {
        input: WorkExecutorRunControl;
        output: WorkExecutorRunControlResult;
    };
}

export interface WorkExecutorMode {
    id: string;
    title: string;
}

export type WorkExecutorRole = (typeof WORK_EXECUTOR_ROLES)[number];

export interface WorkExecutorRoleContract {
    readonly operation: "query" | "command";
    readonly input_type: string;
    readonly output_type: string;
    readonly input_schema: ActionSchema;
    readonly output_schema: ActionSchema;
}

interface DestinationDeclaration {
    readonly title: string;
    readonly verb: string;
    readonly describe: string;
    readonly material_field?: string;
    readonly prepare?: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;

    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
};

    id: string;
    title: string;
    icon: string;
    create?: boolean;
    subject_kind: string;
    read_permissions: readonly string[];
    write_permissions: readonly string[];
    receive_scheduling?: "concurrent";
}
